author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a boxy vest whose zigzag lapel notches crossed into a knot, with sleeves missing. Redrawn from the reference: sloped shoulders, long sleeves widening to the cuffs with seams up to the armpits, V opening from the collar corners to the button point, front edge down to the hem. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Lapel notch outlines and the cutaway hem (an 18-wide front cannot hold 8-unit lapel bands; the cutaway came within 8 of the sleeve seams).
